description: Founding confirmed-behavior rows locked at task-644 merge (22b2671, 2026-08-06). Encode the CORRECT post-fix behavior. These are regression targets — any change to a covered behavior must add a new row (bump rev) and update the sha256 field if the calibration block changed.

rows.description: time-domain RMS gate fires on normal speech — iOS Safari 26 fix (task-644)
rows.claimed: getByteTimeDomainData replaces getByteFrequencyData at all 3 VAD RMS compute sites; fallback thresholds recalibrated to time-domain scale (was frequency-domain 0.115, now time-domain 0.085)
rows.note: time-domain RMS = sqrt(mean((v-128)^2))/128, range 0-1. Normal speech reads 0.05-0.25; ambient noise 0.005-0.025. Threshold 0.085 is reachable without shouting.

rows.description: beside-cheek pose accepted: wrist(0.72,0.78) with anchored face = IN; hand-overlapping-face NOT required (task-644 cheek-zone relax)
rows.claimed: GESTURE_ZONE_SPEC.rx 0.17->0.21, ry 0.22->0.26, minTipsInside 3->2, _FACE_SIDE_GAP 0.03->0.10 — ovals pushed further from face edge so beside-cheek pose naturally lands inside the oval
rows.note: Acceptance: palm-centre OR >= 2 fingertips inside oval. Face-anchored: ovals move with detected face position. Fallback to GESTURE_ZONE_SPEC fixed constants when no confident face read.

rows.description: drawn guide and acceptance gate consume identical _activeZone() numbers — single source of truth maintained
rows.claimed: _avDrawHand/_drawFingerTargetGuide both call _activeZone() for oval geometry; _handNearFaceZone acceptance gate also calls _activeZone(); no separate constant path exists for either
rows.note: Zone parity: guide scale factor is `z.rx / GESTURE_ZONE_SPEC.rx` applied to _activeZone() output — guide is always proportionally wider than acceptance gate using the SAME anchored oval centres. Any divergence would mean a visible 'green zone' different from what actually accepts.
